_comment: do.c flooreffects() 289-297: an object that lands on the square where the hero teeters at the edge of a seen pit 'tumbles into' the pit named by the_your[t->madeby_u], or, while the hero is blind and not deaf, is heard to 'tumble downwards'. A dwarvish Archeologist digs a pit with her pick-axe (madeby_u), crawls to its edge, drops a touchstone ('your pit'), then wishes for and puts on a blindfold and drops her tinning kit. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
